name: Right Heart Man
source:
Anthonny, a very unfortunate guy, runs away from home and faces the world with his fluffiness. Riddled with doubt whether he'll make it 'til the next day, he crosses his way with an unexpected Buddy, or better company for life...

[From [url=https://tavios.itch.io/right-heart-man]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
安东尼是一个非常不幸的人，他离家出走，用他的毛茸茸的东西面对世界。他满腹疑问自己是否能坚持到第二天，却遇到了一位意想不到的好友，或者是一生中更好的陪伴……

[来自[url=https://tavios.itch.io/right-heart-man]Itch.io[/url]]
